svg.title: Docker targets: backend group, identity and explicit recreation
svg.desc: The external path planner selects affected Dockerfile inputs and target images. Native view-only changes do not select Linux image builds. Verify Docker context, daemon and builder architecture and choose linux/amd64 or linux/arm64 plus a unique IMAGE_TAG that preserves aliases used by existing stacks. The Bake backend group builds exactly runtime, surrealdb and search-index. Runtime contains the shared service host; search-index uses only contracts and search source in a separate compile graph; the digest-pinned database wrapper has its own target. Retain exact loaded image IDs, platform, tags and Buildx metadata. Hash-verified matching Linux model and native-library assets are separate staged dependencies for explicitly selected inference roles. Explicitly recreate only selected owned services under isolated workspace, project and ports while preserving data, credentials, identities, caches and unrelated images. Native app packaging, web images and retained Venture or CLI targets remain independent.
svg.text: NARROW INPUTS · MATCHING LINUX PLATFORM · REVIEW TAGS THAT PRESERVE EXISTING ALIASES
Choose only the affected image targets
Verify builder / daemon platform and unique review tag
Choose linux/amd64 or linux/arm64 deliberately; record the actual Docker context and builder.
IMAGE_TAG keeps existing :local / version aliases intact. Reuse architecture-scoped BuildKit caches.
Build from the repository root; print the selected Bake plan before loading its targets.
Native view sources are not copied
No core inference / CLI / native / Next build
Retain image IDs / platform / review tags
Stage only for selected inference roles
Exact tags / IDs; dedicated project and ports
Web and Venture / CLI compatibility targets stay separate. Native app builds do not provision Docker or mutate the user's stack.
Keep unrelated images and aliases. Loading differs from recreation, health, integration and real model inference.
